in_sanskrit.name: गौद
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Goud' is believed to have originated from the Sanskrit word 'gau' meaning 'cow' and 'da' meaning 'giver' or 'provider'. Thus, 'Goud' can be interpreted as 'giver of cows' or 'provider of cows'.

in_tamil.name: கௌத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of the name 'Goud' is 'கோப்புரியர்' (kōppuriyar), which means 'provider of cows'. This meaning is derived from the Sanskrit origin of the name, where 'gau' means 'cow' and 'da' means 'giver' or 'provider'.

in_telugu.name: గౌద్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of the name 'Goud' is 'గౌదేశ' (gāudēśa), which means 'lord of cows'. This meaning is derived from the Sanskrit origin of the name, where 'gau' means 'cow' and 'da' means 'giver' or 'provider'.

in_marathi.name: Goud
in_marathi.long_meaning: Goud हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Haudh' or 'Gouda', meaning 'God' or 'Gold'. This name signifies divine blessings, wealth, and prosperity.
